snippet.title: Bibi & Tina – Ready, Set, Ride! Game for Switch, PS4, PS5, Xbox and PC. Official English video.
snippet.description:
🎮 Available from 24 September 2026 on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PS4, PS5 and XBOX!

A summer full of friendship, tournament excitement and horse-filled happiness: Ride with Bibi, Tina and Alex as they compete for the cup, stand together against unfair rivals – and dive into varied horse-riding adventures. Action-packed carriage races are among the special highlights.

What awaits you:
🐎 Experience an exciting Bibi & Tina adventure – with lots of great tasks and horse-filled moments!
👭 Play as Bibi, Tina or Alex – together with Sabrina, Amadeus, Maharaja and seven more horses that you can unlock.
🛞 Discover the special highlight: carriage driving with races and slalom courses.
🏆 Train for different tournament disciplines and collect points for the final.
🏁 Ride checkpoint races, show jumping, slalom, flag races, ring jousting and trail races.
💖 Care for your horse by brushing it, feeding it, picking out its hooves, decorating it and cooling it down.
🗺️ Explore familiar places such as Martin's Farm, Falkenstein Castle, the Old Mill, Wolf's Gorge, the forest and Redwell Castle.


🎮 You can get the game here:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3969340/Bibi__Tina__Ready_Set_Ride
Switch: ** coming soon **
PS4 & PS5: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10018279/
XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/en-gb/games/store/bibi-tina-ready-set-ride/9p49803sfg9g
